question.text: Within how many days must trustees give notice to SEBI when a scheme is to be wound up?

explanation.text: The Logic: When a scheme is to be wound up, the trustees shall give notice within one day to SEBI and in two daily newspapers (NISM-Series-III-C workbook, p.251). The Trap: Other timing rules in the regulations use longer windows (such as 7-day or 15-day periods on pp.245, 254-255, and 266), but the winding-up notice to SEBI and the press is specifically a one-day requirement. Note: Memorise the source-backed one-day notice rule for scheme winding up rather than inferring it from general urgency or materiality considerations.
